title: Try token mode from a plain HTML page (IIFE + publishable key)
caption: How a third-party browser frontend uses the SDK (build-your-own-frontend guide §2.3, §3, §4). Needs the stack of the smoke-test flow, a built SDK and a publishable test key whose allowed origins list your page's origin.

steps.title: Create a publishable key for your page's origin
steps.body: Create a **Publishable key** with the allowed origin `http://localhost:8080` (the seeded `pk_test_` key has no origins, so a browser page is refused). Copy the key: it is shown once.
steps.expect: `SELECT prefix, allowed_origins FROM platform.api_keys WHERE kind = 'publishable' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;` lists `{http://localhost:8080}`.

steps.title: Serve a page with the IIFE
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-sdk build`, copy `ota/sdk/dist/velexis-sdk.iife.js` next to an `index.html` that has `<script src="velexis-sdk.iife.js"></script>`, and serve the folder on port 8080 with any static server (for example `python3 -m http.server 8080`).
steps.expect: In the DevTools console `typeof Velexis.createVelexisClient` is `"function"`; the page loaded nothing else and made no request.

steps.title: Create the client and bootstrap
steps.body: `const v = Velexis.createVelexisClient({ publishableKey: "pk_test_…", baseUrl: "http://localhost:4000" }); await v.storefront.get();`
steps.expect: The OTA's `StorefrontConfig`. Network tab: a preflight `OPTIONS` answered `204`, then `GET /v1/storefront` with `X-Api-Key`, answer headers `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:8080` and `Vary: Origin`, and no cookie sent (`credentials: omit`).

steps.title: Search, page through and price
steps.body: `const s = await v.flights.search({ mode: "simple", originLocationCode: "PAR", destinationLocationCode: "NYC", departureDate: "<a date 30 days ahead>", adults: 1, currencyCode: "EUR", resultOptions: { limit: 5 } });` then `const page = await v.flights.listResults({ searchId: s.id, limit: 5 }); for await (const o of page) { … }` and `await v.flights.price({ offerIds: [s.offers[0].id] });`
steps.expect: `srch_…` with status `completed`; `for await` fetches the next pages only as you iterate; `prc_…` with status `active`. Each POST carries a fresh `Idempotency-Key`.

steps.title: Sign up and act as the customer
steps.body: `const r = await v.auth.signUp({ email, password, firstName, lastName, marketingConsent: false, termsVersion: (await v.storefront.get()).legal.termsVersion });` then `const me = v.withOptions({ accessToken: r.session.accessToken, refreshToken: r.session.refreshToken, onSessionRefreshed: (s) => console.log("rotated") }); await me.account.get();`
steps.expect: `201` with `cus_…` and a session (unless the OTA requires verification first: then `session: null`). `account.get` answers the profile with `emailVerified: false`.

steps.title: Try the refusals
steps.body: `await v.console.auth.me()`; `Velexis.createVelexisClient({ secretKey: "sk_test_x" })`; `await v.checkout.completeWithAirlineCard({ … })`; from another origin (port 9999) `await v.storefront.get()`.
steps.expect: `PermissionError` `403 SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED`; `TypeError` (secret key in a browser page, before any request); `403 SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED` (`edge_only`); `PermissionError` `403 ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` after one request: the API opens that refusal to the page's origin so that the page can read it.
